CHID 100: THIS COURSE INTRODUCES STUDENTS TO SOME OF THE GENRES AND MODES OF THINKING IN THE HUMANITIES AND MAKES A CASE FOR THEIR RELEVANCE IN REPAIRING A WOUNDED WORLD. HOW CAN LITERARY, PHILOSOPHICAL, ARTISTIC, AND HISTORICAL WAYS OF THINKING HELP US RESPOND TO URGENT ISSUES LIKE WAR, CLIMATE CHANGE, GENOCIDE, AND STRUCTURAL VIOLENCE, BOTH LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY? THIS COURSE EXPLORES KEYWORDS OF THE HUMANITIES AS SITES OF CONTENTION, DELIBERATION, AND INSPIRATION, AS THEY HAVE THE POWER TO HARM AND HEAL.
CHID 101: CHID MAJORS & MINORS ONLY CONTACT CHID(AT)UW.EDU FOR ADD CODE
CHID 211: APOCALYPSE AND POPULAR CULTURE(AH, DIV) ___ HOW OFTEN, AND FOR WHOM, DOES THE WORLD END? POPULAR CULTURE SHOWS A PERSISTENT FASCINATION WITH APOCALYPTIC SCENARIOS. THIS COURSE USES CRITICAL INQUIRY AND SPECULATIVE THINKING TO EXAMINE A WIDE RANGE OF MEDIA, INCLUDING FILM, TELEVISION, VIDEO GAMES, LITERATURE, VISUAL AND THEATER ART, AND DIGITAL MEDIA. IT FOCUSES ON QUESTIONS OF POWER AND DIFFERENCE, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, IDEAS OF THE FUTURE, AND THE POLITICS OF REPRESENTATION.
CHID 270: "BODIES IN TRANSITION" HOW HAVE SCHOLARS, WRITERS, AND ARTISTS ENVISIONED EXTENDING THE BODY VIA TECHNOLOGY? HOW HAS LITERATURE, FILM, AND VIDEO ART CONSTRUCTED, CONTESTED, AND REIMAGINED THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN DRAG, GENDER DIVERSITY, AND GENDER TRANSITIONS? WHAT DO WE MEAN WHEN W SPEAK ABOUT "PASSING" BODIES? HOW D EXPERIENCES OF DISCRIMINATION AND VIOLENCE SHAPE A BODY AND ITS PERCEPTIONS
CHID 275: MUSIC AND SOCIAL MOVEMENTS (AH, DIV ) ___ THIS CLASS EXPLORES THE HISTORY AND INFLUENCE OF THE BLACK POWER MOVEMENT ON HIP HOP CULTURE. WE WIL ALSO CONSIDER THE COMMERCIALIZATION AND GLOBALIZATION OF HIP HOP, WITH A FOCUS ON RAP.
CHID 390: COLLOQUIUM IN THE HISTORY OF IDEAS - THE ECOLOGICAL THOUGHT (AH) ___ THIS SEMINAR INVITES STUDENTS TO THINK AND RETHINK THE ECOLOGICAL THOUGHT, USING PHILOSOPHER TIMOTHY MORTONS PHRASE. IT ASKS WHAT IT MEANS TO UNDERSTAND ALL BEINGS AS FUNDAMENTALLY INTERCONNECTED, TO RECOGNIZE OUR PLACE WITHIN A VAST, INESCAPABLE MESH, AND TO LIVE IN WAYS THAT HONOR THIS DEEP ENTANGLEMENT. AS THE JUNIOR COLLOQUIUM, THE COURSE EMPHASIZES ENGAGEMENT WITH THE POLITICS OF KNOWLEDGE, ASKING HOW WE COME TO KNOW WHAT WE KNOW, WHAT COUNTS AS KNOWLEDGE, AND WHOSE KNOWLEDGE MATTERS.
CHID 488: ENCOUNTERING ANIMALS - MORE-THAN- HUMAN WORLDS IN RELATION (SSC, AH) ___ THIS SEMINAR INVITES STUDENTS TO ENGAGE ANIMALS, PLANTS, AND THE BROADER MORE-THAN-HUMAN WORLD AS AGENTIVE, ANIMATE, AND ENTANGLED WITH HUMAN LIFEWORLDS. DRAWING ON FRAMEWORKS AND METHODS FROM INDIGENOUS EPISTEMOLOGIES, CRITICAL ANIMAL STUDIES, MULTISPECIES ETHNOGRAPHY, AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL HUMANITIES, AND ENGAGING A RANGE OF LITERARY, VISUAL, AND ORAL TEXTS, THE COURSE EXPLORES BOTH HUMAN AND MORE-THAN-HUMAN DIMENSIONS OF RACIAL FORMATIONS, SETTLER COLONIALISM, EXTRACTIVE CAPITALISM, CAPTIVITY, WAR, AND OTHER FORMS OF VIOLENCE.
CHID 491: "CHID SENIOR PROJECT" (SSC) (CHID MAJORS ONLY) CONTACT CHID[AT]UW.EDU FOR ADD CODE.
CHID 495: VIOLENT INTIMACIES - CARE, CONSUMPTION, BODIES (AH, SSC) ___ THIS CLOSE READING SEMINAR INVITES STUDENTS TO CONSIDER THE POLITICS OF CARE, CONSUMPTION AND BODIES. HOW DO DISABLED ARTISTS, INDIGENOUS THINKERS, AND BLACK WRITERS EXPAND OUR THINKING ABOUT THESE THEMES? BY CRITICALLY EXPLORING A VARIETY OF LITERARY GENRES, INCLUDING SCHOLARLY TEXTS, NOVELS, POEMS, AND SHORT STORIES, THIS COURSE ASKS: WHAT DO ZOMBIES, GHOSTS, AND SHAPESHIFTERS TEACH US ABOUT THE COMPLICATED CONTOURS OF LOVE?

ANALYTICAL TECHNIQUES IN GEOSCIENCES ------------------------- COURSE DESCRIPTION: EVER WONDERED HOW SCIENTISTS PIN DOWN A MINERAL'S EXACT COMPOSITION, DATE A ROCK, OR TRACE A CONTAMINANT DOWN TO THE ATOMIC SCALE? THIS COURSE TAKES YOU BEHIND THE INSTRUMENTS THAT MAKE MODERN GEOSCIENCE RESEARCH AND INDUSTRY WORK POSSIBLE. YOU'LL LEARN THE THEORY BEHIND THE MAJOR ANALYTICAL TECHNIQUES USED TO IDENTIFY AND INVESTIGATE GEOLOGICAL SAMPLES, THEN GO HANDS-ON WITH THE ACTUAL INSTRUMENTS IN UW'S FACILITIES TO RUN ANALYSES YOURSELF. YOU WILL UNDERSTAND WHAT IS HAPPENING INSIDE AN X-RAY DIFFRACTOMETER, A RAMAN OR FTIR SPECTROMETER, A MASS SPECTROMETER, AN ELECTRON MICROPROBE (EPMA), A SCANNING ELECTRON MICROSCOPE (SEM/EBSD) AND EVEN GET A LOOK AT SYNCHROTRON-BASED TECHNIQUES. GET PRACTICAL EXPERIENCE WITH INSTRUMENTATION THAT GRAD SCHOOL ADVISORS AND FUTURE EMPLOYERS APPRECIATE.
